tsk-4c1.title: Fix quick-add cwd resolution: use main checkout root, not worktree
tsk-4c1.description:
Fix quick-add cwd resolution: use main checkout root, not worktree

On the home page's + button (workspace quick-add and the FAB), the seeded cwd for a newly created shell or agent should resolve to the main checkout root, not a git worktree. Currently every new shell/agent created this way lands inside a worktree instead.
tsk-4c1.verify: chưa xác định — P15 bổ sung

decisions.text: tsk-4c1: discovery findings complete (root cause confirmed, RESEARCH.md written), but 'fgos discover --verdict clear' fails: .fgos/config.json#runner has only the legacy 'executor' (singular) shape, missing the 'executors' map (e.g. executors.pi) this installed fgos CLI now requires even when a caller supplies --verdict directly. This repo's .fgos/config.json was never migrated to the newer schema (compare forgentX's own .fgos/config.json, which has the full executors map). Stopping the /fgOS:cook autonomous drive here to report the environment blocker rather than guess a config fix with security-relevant side effects (e.g. codex's bypass-sandbox executor).
decisions.rationale: Infrastructure blocker outside this item's own scope; reported to the user rather than silently patched
